title: Civil War
description: The Imperial Legion and the Stormcloaks fight for control of Skyrim.

items.title: Choosing a Side
items.description: Join the Imperial Legion under General Tullius at Castle Dour (Solitude) or the Stormcloaks under Ulfric at the Palace of the Kings (Windhelm).
tips: If the war gets in the way of the main quest, you can pause it in "Season Unending".
Victory replaces the jarls in many holds — finish their quests first if they matter to you.
items.missable: Once you swear an oath to one side, the other side's quests are gone for good.

choices.question: Which side do you fight for?

options.label: Imperial Legion
options.result: You fight for the Empire under General Tullius and Legate Rikke; Ulfric dies in the finale.

options.label: Stormcloaks
options.result: You fight for Skyrim's independence under Ulfric and Galmar Stone-Fist; Tullius dies in the finale.

items.title: The Jagged Crown
items.description: Beat the enemy to the ancient barrow of Korvanjund and claim the Jagged Crown, the symbol of Skyrim's High King.
tips: Enemy soldiers guard the barrow entrance — be ready for a fight outside.

items.title: Message to Whiterun
items.description: Deliver your side's message to Jarl Balgruuf. His answer leads to the battle for Whiterun.
tips: If the main quest hasn't reached "The Fallen" yet, this quest may stall — Balgruuf is stalling.

items.title: Battle for Whiterun
items.description: For the Legion ("Defense of Whiterun"), hold Whiterun against the Stormcloaks; for the Stormcloaks, storm the city and overthrow Balgruuf.
items.missable: If the Stormcloaks win, Balgruuf and Proventus go into exile and Vignar Gray-Mane becomes jarl — the old court's quests and services change.

items.title: Joining the Legion
items.description: Pass Rikke's test — clear Fort Hraggstad of bandits — and swear your oath to the Empire.

items.title: Get Outfitted
items.description: Collect your Imperial armor from the Legion quartermaster.

items.title: A False Front
items.description: Intercept a Stormcloak courier and swap his orders for forged ones to weaken the enemy before the assault.

items.title: The Battle for Fort Dunstad
items.description: Take Fort Dunstad so the Pale (Dawnstar) falls to the Empire.

items.title: Compelling Tribute
items.description: Convince a hold's steward to secretly back the Empire — by persuasion, blackmail or threats.

items.title: The Battle for Fort Greenwall
items.description: Capture Fort Greenwall in the Rift. Afterwards Maven Black-Briar becomes Jarl of Riften.
items.missable: Riften gets a new jarl: Laila Law-Giver steps down, and her tasks and court positions become unavailable.

items.title: Rescue from Fort Kastav
items.description: Free the captured legionnaires held by the Stormcloaks at Fort Kastav.

items.title: The Battle for Fort Amol
items.description: The last fort before Windhelm. Its fall opens the way to the Stormcloak capital.

items.title: Battle for Windhelm
items.description: Storm Windhelm and face Ulfric Stormcloak in the Palace of the Kings.
tips: You can deliver the final blow to Ulfric yourself or leave it to Tullius.
items.missable: Ulfric and Galmar die; quests and dialogue tied to them become unavailable.

items.title: Remaining Fort Battles (Imperial)
items.description: If the war goes on after "Season Unending", retake the holds ceded in the treaty: "The Battle for Fort Neugrad", "The Battle for Fort Sungard", "The Battle for Fort Snowhawk".

items.title: Joining the Stormcloaks
items.description: Pass Galmar's test on the island near Windhelm and swear your oath to Ulfric.

items.title: Rescue from Fort Neugrad
items.description: Free the captured Stormcloaks from Fort Neugrad.

items.title: Compelling Tribute
items.description: Convince a hold's steward to secretly back the Stormcloaks — by persuasion, blackmail or threats.

items.title: The Battle for Fort Sungard
items.description: Capture Fort Sungard in the Reach to break the Empire's hold on Markarth.

items.title: A False Front
items.description: Intercept an Imperial courier and swap his orders for forged ones.

items.title: The Battle for Fort Snowhawk
items.description: Take Fort Snowhawk so Hjaalmarch falls to the Stormcloaks.

items.title: The Battle for Fort Hraggstad
items.description: The last fort on the approach to Solitude.

items.title: Battle for Solitude
items.description: Storm Solitude and face General Tullius at Castle Dour.
tips: Ulfric offers you the chance to execute Tullius yourself.
items.missable: Tullius and Rikke die; quests and dialogue tied to them become unavailable.

items.title: Remaining Fort Battles (Stormcloak)
items.description: If the war goes on after "Season Unending", retake the holds ceded in the treaty: "The Battle for Fort Greenwall", "The Battle for Fort Dunstad", "The Battle for Fort Kastav".
